scenes.alt: 초록 모자를 쓴 다온의 모습이 담긴 영상을 친구들이 보고, 곁에 있는 다온은 당황한 표정으로 화면을 바라봅니다.
scenes.caption: 다온의 얼굴이 보여도, 정말 다온이 한 말일까요?
scenes.scene: In a bright cozy community learning room, two friends examine a tablet resting upright on a desk. The tablet prominently displays a natural-looking recorded video portrait of DAON with a simple play triangle, no text. The real DAON stands beside the desk with one open hand, mildly surprised and worried because the words in the circulating video are not his. MOA is one of the two viewers, looking uncertain rather than angry; the second viewer is a child with short black hair and a blue hoodie. Clearly distinguish tablet video from real DAON. No villains. Show the uncertainty before any response.

The original friendly play footage contrasts with their uncertain reaction to added sound.
